preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in ns)
all(0 <= k <= n for k in ks)
preconditions.description: Each k is between 0 and n.
Sum of all n values across test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], str) for i in range(T))
all(output[i] == '-1' or (len(output[i].split()) == ns[i] and all(int(x) in range(1, ns[i]+1) for x in output[i].split())) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output is either '-1' or a permutation of numbers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all((output[i] == '-1') == (ks[i] > ns[i] - 1) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Output is '-1' if and only if k is greater than n-1.

postconditions.expression: all((output[i] != '-1') == (any(sum(int(x) == j+1 for j, x in enumerate(output[i].split())) == ks[i] for i in range(T)))
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', there exists a permutation with exactly k fixed points.
